metadata.question: Was a phytoplankton bloom visible between 56° to 68° South latitude on January 13, 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need ocean color data to detect phytoplankton blooms - Use MODIS Aqua or Terra ocean color products (chlorophyll-a concentration) - Date: January 13, 2016 - Location: Southern Ocean, 56°S to 68°S latitude (need to define longitude range - will use global belt) - Collection: "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI" for chlorophyll 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean color data already has quality flags - Mask land and invalid data - Look for elevated chlorophyll-a levels indicating blooms (typically >0.5 mg/m³ can indicate blooms in Southern Ocean) 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid detection (A): Images exist, valid pixels present, elevated chlorophyll detected - No bloom (B): Images exist, valid pixels present, but no elevated chlorophyll - C1: No images for the date - C2: Images exist but no valid ocean pixels after masking - C3: Calculation returns null/invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const targetDate = '2016-01-13'; const startDate = '2016-01-12'; const endDate = '2016-01-14'; // Southern Ocean belt between 56°S and 68°S const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({ coords: [-180, -68, 180, -56], geodesic: false }); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); const collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try Terra as fallback collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Terra/L3SMI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); const terraSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Terra images found: ${terraSize}`); if (terraSize === 0) { console.log('No ocean color data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Get chlorophyll-a data const image = collection.first(); const chlorophyll = image.select('chlor_a'); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = await chlorophyll.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid ocean pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid ocean pixels in region.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate statistics for bloom detection const stats = await chlorophyll.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.percentile([50, 90, 95]), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const median = stats['chlor_a_p50']; const p90 = stats['chlor_a_p90']; const p95 = stats['chlor_a_p95']; console.log(`Chlorophyll-a median: ${median ? median.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`); console.log(`Chlorophyll-a 90th percentile: ${p90 ? p90.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`); console.log(`Chlorophyll-a 95th percentile: ${p95 ? p95.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (median === null || median === undefined || isNaN(median)) { console.log('Invalid calculation results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Phytoplankton bloom threshold for Southern Ocean // Blooms typically show elevated chlorophyll (>0.5 mg/m³, with patches >1.0 mg/m³) const bloomThreshold = 0.5; if (p90 > bloomThreshold) { console.log(`Bloom detected: 90th percentile (${p90.toFixed(3)}) exceeds ${bloomThreshold} mg/m³`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No significant bloom: 90th percentile (${p90.toFixed(3)}) below ${bloomThreshold} mg/m³`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
